text: Requisitos de admisión 1. Estudiantes con recursos propios: solicitantes de entre 18 y 35 años (hasta el 31 de diciembre del año de solicitud, inclusive).PRINTNo citizen Chinese or other citizens who have graduated from high school or above and are in good health; 2. Applicants who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, or who have been a foreign national since birth must meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12; 3. Applicants under the age of 18 (before August 31 in the current year) should click here to view the requirements. 4. Proof of language proficiency IELTS 6.5, TOEFL IBT 81 or above. 5. Students applying for the Architecture(InternationalClass)program must take the CSCA Mathematics and Physics exams(the exam papers are in English).
